verses.english: A Realized One Both Still Exists and No Longer Exists

verses.pali: “Kismiṁ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṁ upādāya, kiṁ abhinivissa evaṁ diṭṭhi uppajjati:
verses.english: “Mendicants, when what exists, because of grasping what and insisting on what, does the view arise:

verses.pali: ‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’”ti?
verses.english: ‘A realized one both still exists and no longer exists after death’?” …
